body_html:
"Pathways" innovation is good, but we also need to inspire students to be pathfinders, trailblazers. #VirginiaQuality #thoughtvectors

— Gardner Campbell (@GardnerCampbell) June 9, 2015

@jgmac1106 Here the analogy breaks down a bit....

— Gardner Campbell (@GardnerCampbell) June 9, 2015

@jgmac1106 Too often we turn students' habitat of learning and interests into a wilderness of our own, then drop them in. #VirginiaQuality

— Gardner Campbell (@GardnerCampbell) June 9, 2015

@GardnerCampbell Or build fences around their habitat of learning and say stay out while inside our walls.

— Greg McVerry (@jgmac1106) June 9, 2015
